map.估算常见产品的虚拟水消耗量。: Estimate the virtual water consumption of a product from its type and output for product water footprint and supply-chain assessment.
map.牛肉≈15415 L/kg，棉衬衫≈2700 L/件，咖啡≈140 L/杯: Beef ≈ 15415 L/kg, cotton shirt ≈ 2700 L/piece, coffee ≈ 140 L/cup
map.虚拟水消耗常远高于直接用水。: Virtual water consumption is often far higher than direct water use.
map.产品核算：录入单位产品耗水与污染稀释水量，求水足迹。: Product accounting: enter the water use per unit product and the dilution water for pollution to obtain the water footprint.
map.供应链评估：对多环节录入，定位高耗水工序。: Supply-chain assessment: enter data for multiple stages to locate the most water-intensive processes.
map.教学演示：演示虚拟水（生产耗水）概念。: Teaching demo: demonstrate the concept of virtual water (water consumed in production).
map.示例：1 kg 棉花耗水约 10000 L（蓝+绿），饮品生产含原料虚拟水更大。: Example: 1 kg of cotton consumes about 10000 L of water (blue + green), and beverage production involves even more virtual water from raw materials.
map.蓝绿灰水分别？: What are blue, green and grey water?
map.蓝=灌溉抽取、绿=雨水蓄积、灰=稀释污染需水量，三者合计为水足迹。结果按公开标准: Blue = irrigation withdrawal, green = stored rainwater, grey = the water needed to dilute pollution; the three together make up the water footprint. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.和用水量不同？: How does it differ from water use?
map.水足迹含供应链虚拟水，远大于终端直接用水量，视角更全。结果按公开标准与环境因子估: The water footprint includes the virtual water of the supply chain and is far larger than the direct end-use volume, giving a fuller picture. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
